name: Freezed
summary: A Dart and Flutter code generator for immutable data classes and sealed or union-style models with generated equality, copyWith, and related utilities.
advantages: Generates immutable-model boilerplate such as equality and copyWith
Useful for sealed or union-style state modeling
tradeoffs: Requires generated files and build tooling
Freezed 4.0.1 currently requires Dart 3.13, so projects on older Dart versions need a compatible release
recommendedFor: Projects with many immutable domain or UI-state models
Projects that benefit from sealed classes and exhaustive state modeling

verification.reason: Current pub.dev metadata and repository documentation are sufficient.
